description: Use when a traveler asks which eSIM to get for a trip. Input: destination (or every country of a multi-country trip in destinations), trip length in days, and how they use data if known. Estimates the GB the trip needs (need_gb, same formula as estimate_data), then returns up to 3 Bloomy eSIM plans with a reason each: best_fit (lowest price in our catalog that covers the estimate), budget (cheaper, below the estimate) and roomier (next size up). A multi-country trip is matched to one regional plan that covers every country. Each option has data, validity, networks (4G/5G per carrier), top-up support, price_jpy, price_usd and price_as_of, plus purchase_url (the checkout confirmation page; the traveler pays there).

activities.description: What the traveler will use mobile data for, when they say so, e.g. ["maps", "social", "video_call"]. hotspot_light / hotspot_heavy mean sharing the connection with another device. Overrides usage. Same categories as bloomyesim.com/data-calculator.

days.description: Required. Trip length in days, integer 1 to 180 (the whole trip for a multi-country trip). Example: 7.

destination.description: One country or region for a single-country trip. Country name in English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish or French, common names included (e.g. "Turkey", "Türkiye", "トルコ", "튀르키예", "Hawaii") or an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("TR"). Use destinations instead for several countries.

destinations.description: Every country of a multi-country trip (2 to 5 entries; names in any supported language or ISO alpha-2 codes), e.g. ["France", "Italy", "Spain"]. One eSIM that covers all of them is searched. Use instead of destination.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

min_gb.description: Data the traveler already knows they want, in GB for the whole trip (e.g. 10). Skips the estimate; overrides usage and activities.

usage.description: Rough data usage when activities are not known: light = maps and messaging, normal = maps, messaging, web and social (default), heavy = normal plus video streaming. Ignored when activities or min_gb is given.

wifi.description: How often the traveler will be on hotel or cafe Wi-Fi instead of mobile data: rarely, sometimes (default) or often. More Wi-Fi lowers the estimate.
